valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 11.94, price over EPS 13.20); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

flags.label: Persistently weak cash conversion
flags.detail: Operating cash flow has been under 80% of net profit for 2 straight periods (latest 0.60x).
